logfileFlush.semantics: Q2PRO logfile_open: 0 = CRT default buffering, 1 = setvbuf _IOLBF (full buffering on the MSVC CRT), >1 = _IONBF

logtoggle.name: logtoggle

cfgTexts.loop:
set q2l_armpos ""
set q2l_seq 0
alias q2l_loop "exec q2l_ctl.cfg; wait 13; q2l_loop"
q2l_loop
cfgTexts.controlIdle:
echo POS $cl_demopos FS $vid_fullscreen P $cl_paused
logfile 0
logfile 2
cfgTexts.controlFirstCommand:
echo POS $cl_demopos FS $vid_fullscreen P $cl_paused
if $q2l_seq != 1 then "exec q2l_cmd_1.cfg; set q2l_seq 1; echo ACK 1"
logfile 0
logfile 2

notableLines: The Chastity Belt Duel  -  by JaLisK0
